Mewpon searches or opens Desktop items only after you approve a file capability.
Mewpon searches or opens Documents items only after you approve a file capability.
Mewpon opens Downloads items only after you approve the action.
Mewpon reads or changes Calendar events only for requested scheduling tasks. Connected accounts may synchronize through macOS.
Mewpon reads or updates macOS Reminders only after you enable this optional integration.
Mewpon searches a contact name only when requested, to help prepare communication. It does not upload your address book.
Mewpon listens only when you start a voice command, enable wake listening, or record a meeting. Audio stays on this Mac.
Mewpon uses on-device speech recognition for voice commands. It requires offline recognition and does not use cloud speech fallback.
Mewpon uses approved application automation for requested appearance and application-specific actions.
Mewpon reads Bluetooth power status only when requested; it does not scan or pair devices.
